title: Prove saturation of the fixed #4467 leaf deficit (no new κ)
body:
Proves #4467’s qualitative saturation conjecture for its fixed raw-p7 leaf law: the conditional deficit converges to an exponential distribution, with convergence of its mean uniformly across lockstep offsets. Exact rational bounds place the limiting mean leaf log-depth in [136.51870330, 136.51870331].

The proof applies Stone’s classical nonlattice interval local-limit theorem and supplies the uniform tail bound needed for convergence of the mean. The source law has G conditioned paid ranks plus one independent, unconditioned terminal rank; the source checks preserve that distinction.

Following Claude Code (Opus 5.5)’s review of `ff365dba`, this revision sharpens the Stone citation and observable definition, clarifies source-check coverage, and adds standalone source authentication plus independent remainder and semantic mutation controls. The theorem and numerical bounds are unchanged.

[Research package](https://github.com/DLamdata/integer-mult-bounds/tree/6310550e932de70243fc2aaab6f4885688b6fe21/research/direct-flow-leaf-saturation) · [Review response](https://github.com/DLamdata/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6310550e932de70243fc2aaab6f4885688b6fe21/research/direct-flow-leaf-saturation/CLAUDE-RESPONSE.md) · [Verification and logs](https://github.com/DLamdata/integer-mult-bounds/blob/6310550e932de70243fc2aaab6f4885688b6fe21/research/direct-flow-leaf-saturation/VALIDATION.md) · [Coordination](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19240402)

Base: `721c03822c421b7f7fcbb2598993b947c4d88419`. Contribution: `6310550e932de70243fc2aaab6f4885688b6fe21`.

Registered replay, normal/optimized checks, committed-source/export checks and Git-free replay passed. The independent enclosure checks cover 16 logarithm and 127 exponential arguments and reject all three targeted remainder faults. Follow-up internal AI review found no unresolved blocker. Hosted CI is separate from this local evidence.

No finite-depth rate, stable-share theorem, full-flow ceiling, supplier admission or new κ is established. The selected #6030 result is unchanged. Next useful work is quantitative convergence and analysis of the remaining flow components.

Credit: Ryanson Jonathan / pinterbanget (#4467, #4465), zxv (#4436), Cinna Davis / 1337isnot1337 (#4405), and Jacob Alan Sussman. Prepared for DLamdata with substantial OpenAI Codex (GPT-6 Astra) assistance; initial-snapshot review by Claude Code (Opus 5.5). No independent human or formal verification is claimed. Apache-2.0.
